lines.t: Hello. Are you here for the photography group? We’re waiting for a few more people before we start.
Yes. I’m interested in taking photos around the city. I looked for this entrance yesterday, but the building was closed.
We usually open at ten on Sundays. You’re in the right place now. The group is meeting in Room Two.
Can you explain this map to me? It looks different from the one on your website, so I’m not sure where to go.
Of course. Go past this desk, turn left and take the stairs. Room Two is upstairs, next to the elevator.
Thanks. Does it make sense to start with the beginner group? I’m good at outdoor photos, but I need help with portraits.
Yes. We’re going to start with a short practice session, then talk about the pictures together. You can ask the teacher for help.
Great. Are those bags part of the session? Who do they belong to? I don’t want to leave my things in the wrong place.
They belong to the volunteers. Your group can use the shelves upstairs. There’s no need to pay for a locker.
That’s helpful, thank you. I’m going to try today’s session first, then think about joining the full course.
